newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Feb 10.
newsitem.headline: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Feb 10.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

Australia's largest brewer is expected to announce its results for the six months ended December 31 at about 2400 GMT (11.00 a.m) and the company's chief executive, Ted Kunkel will hold a media conference at 0300 GMT (2.30 p.m). Analysts expect the company to report pre-abnormal net earnings of between A$175 to A$190 million.
On Sunday, John Prescott, the chief executive of the Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd (BHP), Fosters major shareholder, played down speculation that BHP was about to sell its 37 percent stake in Fosters.
Pastoral and energy goup expected to announce its results for the six months ended December 31.
The shares of transport, health and telecommunications group has been downgraded to a sell by broker, First Pacific, the Australian Financial Review newspaper reported on Monday.

Aussie Home Loans, Australia's largest non-bank bank home loan lender, said it has entered the business lending market, in competition with banks, with a range of low interest rate loans which it said it believes will revolutionise Australian business lending.

Gold analysts said on Friday investors were concerned that Acacia Resources had payed too much for its surprise acquisition of a 17.4 percent stake in prospective Gawler Craton explorer Helix Resources.
